description: The terms each existing vulnerability source's source_snapshot must carry in the license and attribution payload keys (eshu-hq/eshu#9958). Both the in-tree collector and the extracted collector build their snapshot from a per-source constant and replay this file to catch drift. license is an SPDX identifier, a LicenseRef- identifier where the source publishes terms with no SPDX identifier, or NOASSERTION where Eshu has found no stated license. It describes the source, not each record: osv mixes licenses per record (Ubuntu and Alpine are CC-BY-SA-4.0, Chainguard and Wolfi are CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0), so it says LicenseRef-OSV-per-record and the attribution points at the per-record list. attribution is one plain-text credit line. A source absent from this file carries neither key; glad (GitLab Advisory Database) is absent on purpose, because its published terms forbid storing the content and are not a license to record. license is a disclosure on the snapshot, not an access decision.
